translation.title: Dexpanthenol (D-Panthenol) Ointment
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used as a supportive treatment for wounds, burns, torn skin (such as cracked nipples during breastfeeding), pressure sores, acute and chronic dermatitis, eczema, skin ulcers, diaper rash, and sunburn (solar dermatitis).
translation.usage: After cleaning the wound, apply to the affected area 1 to 2 times a day, or up to several times a day according to the product's directions. For cracked nipples during breastfeeding, apply to the nipple right after each feeding.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it or to its excipients, or if you have an infectious or oozing (exudative) skin condition. Avoid contact with the eyes. If you have applied this medicine to treat cracked nipples during breastfeeding, wipe it off before nursing. This medicine contains propylene glycol, so consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are hypersensitive to this ingredient or have experienced an allergic reaction to it. Allergic reactions (contact dermatitis, itching, redness, eczema, a rash, hives, skin irritation, blisters) may occur; if they do, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
